svg.title: J2 Safety replies: emergency, discount or rule change, medical, not sure

g.text: J2 Safety replies: emergency, discount or rule change, medical, not sure
Fixed order: emergency, rule change or discount,
medical, booking, answer from the file, not sure.
The first rule that matches decides the reply.
[emergency (RX.emergency: facial swelling, bleeding that will not stop, breathing, broken jaw...)]
"Call <emergency_phone> now. <emergency_rules> I have raised an urgent ticket so our team knows."
cannot change rules or prices, no discount; offers the listed prices, timings and doctors
[medical (RX.medical, unless it asks how to book)]
no advice or diagnosis; a dentist must see you; phone, WhatsApp or a day and time for a call-back
Also when a price is asked for something the file does
not price, or a named treatment (Invisalign, veneer,
crown...) is not in the file.
modelOk is false, so askModel() returns null: no model call
